vsd-heatmaps.protocol:
Train a small heatmap landmark network on published 3D-derived silhouettes.

Fixed protocol: 300 epochs, seed17, existing 15/4 subject split. No selection
on held-out landmark error; four held-out subjects have been inspected before.
This is a synthetic-geometry experiment, not DXA landmark validation.
limitations: Orthographic silhouette; no DXA attenuation or pelvic superposition.
Head center fitted to six median surface landmarks; neck center from four isthmus landmarks.
3D consensus labels projected into 2D; not independent 2D expert annotation.
Native-coordinate rotation is not an expert insufficient/excessive rotation class.
Previously inspected held-out subjects; no independent new cohort.
No DXA segmentation errors or pelvic superposition in this benchmark.

reference labels; this is not a verified AP/lateral benchmark. Prompts are
fixed before inspecting results. All image pixels and checkpoints stay local.
prompts: A frontal anteroposterior DXA image of the lumbar spine and pelvis.
A frontal anteroposterior DXA image of the proximal femur and hip.
A lateral side view DXA image of the thoracic and lumbar spine.
A lateral side view X-ray image of the hip and proximal femur.
limitations: VFA and BMD differ by acquisition field, shape and appearance; projection is confounded with protocol.
No lateral hip reference images are available in this probe.
This is not an estimate on the organiser cohort or a validation of all projection classes.
